opinions: I DISAGREE; MASS SURVEILLANCE ERODES PRIVACY FOR EVERYONE AND CREATES DANGEROUS POWER IMBALANCES EVEN WHEN TARGETED AT WRONGDOERS.
I SUPPORT UNIVERSAL ACCESS TO HIGH-QUALITY HEALTHCARE AS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT; ABILITY TO PAY SHOULD NOT DETERMINE THE STANDARD OF CARE ONE RECEIVES.
SAME-SEX COUPLES IN STABLE, LOVING RELATIONSHIPS SHOULD ABSOLUTELY BE ABLE TO ADOPT; WHAT MATTERS IS THE CHILD'S WELFARE, NOT THE PARENTS' GENDER.
ECONOMIC GLOBALIZATION SHOULD BE STEERED TO SERVE HUMAN WELLBEING, DIGNITY, AND SUSTAINABILITY RATHER THAN PRIMARILY ENRICHING TRANSNATIONAL CORPORATIONS.
MORALITY DOES NOT REQUIRE RELIGION; SECULAR ETHICS BASED ON REASON, EMPATHY, AND HUMAN FLOURISHING ARE ENTIRELY SUFFICIENT.
NO RACE HAS SUPERIOR QUALITIES TO OTHERS; ALL HUMAN BEINGS POSSESS EQUAL INHERENT WORTH REGARDLESS OF ANCESTRY.
I REJECT BLIND PATRIOTISM; ONE SHOULD SUPPORT THEIR COUNTRY WHEN IT IS RIGHT AND OPPOSE IT WHEN IT IS WRONG.
MATURITY SOMETIMES REQUIRES PRINCIPLED OPPOSITION TO THE ESTABLISHMENT RATHER THAN MAKING PEACE WITH IT.
SCHOOLS SHOULD NOT MAKE ATTENDANCE COMPULSORY; EDUCATION IS MOST EFFECTIVE WHEN IT RESPECTS AUTONOMY AND FOSTERS GENUINE CURIOSITY.
THE RICH ARE NOT TOO HIGHLY TAXED; IN MOST DEVELOPED COUNTRIES THEY ENJOY HISTORICALLY LOW EFFECTIVE TAX RATES RELATIVE TO THEIR GAINS AND SOCIETAL BENEFIT.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO CULTIVATE CRITICAL THINKING, CIVIC VIRTUE, EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND LOVE OF LEARNING, NOT MERELY JOB TRAINING.
WHAT IS GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS OFTEN HARMFUL TO WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT.
CIVIL LIBERTIES HAVE BEEN EXCESSIVELY CURBED IN THE NAME OF COUNTER-TERRORISM, OFTEN WITH LITTLE EVIDENCE OF PROPORTIONATE SECURITY GAINS.
IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE, REHABILITATION SHOULD GENERALLY BE PRIORITIZED OVER PURE PUNISHMENT TO REDUCE RECIDIVISM AND PROMOTE A SAFER SOCIETY.
PUBLIC FUNDING FOR INDEPENDENT BROADCASTING INSTITUTIONS LIKE THE BBC SERVES THE PUBLIC INTEREST BY PROVIDING IMPARTIAL, HIGH-QUALITY INFORMATION NOT DRIVEN PURELY BY PROFIT.
OPENNESS ABOUT SEX HAS NOT GONE TOO FAR; HONEST, CONSENSUAL, AND RESPONSIBLE DISCUSSION OF SEXUALITY IS HEALTHY AND REDUCES SHAME.
MOTHERS AND FATHERS SHOULD SHARE EQUALLY IN CAREER AND HOMEMAKING RESPONSIBILITIES; THERE IS NO INHERENT FIRST DUTY FOR MOTHERS TO BE HOMEMAKERS.
THE MOST IMPORTANT THING FOR CHILDREN TO LEARN IS HOW TO THINK CRITICALLY, REGULATE THEIR EMOTIONS, AND TREAT OTHERS WITH EMPATHY AND RESPECT, NOT PRIMARILY TO ACCEPT DISCIPLINE.
A GENUINE FREE MARKET DOES REQUIRE STRONG RESTRICTIONS ON MONOPOLIES AND PREDATORY CORPORATE BEHAVIOR TO PRESERVE REAL COMPETITION.
WHILE PEOPLE HAVE RIGHTS, THE IDEA THAT DIFFERENT SORTS OF PEOPLE SHOULD 'KEEP TO THEIR OWN KIND' PROMOTES HARMFUL SEGREGATION AND CONTRADICTS THE VALUE OF AN OPEN, DIVERSE SOCIETY.
IT IS INDEED REGRETTABLE WHEN VAST FORTUNES ARE ACCUMULATED THROUGH FINANCIAL MANIPULATION THAT CONTRIBUTES NOTHING PRODUCTIVE TO SOCIETY.
IT IS NEVER A COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME TO ATTEMPT REHABILITATION; EVEN IF SUCCESS RATES VARY, GIVING UP ON PEOPLE UNDERMINES OUR HUMANITY AND LONG-TERM SAFETY.
WHILE RANDOMNESS EXISTS, 'NATURALLY UNLUCKY' IS USUALLY A POST-HOC EXPLANATION THAT IGNORES SYSTEMIC FACTORS AND PERSONAL AGENCY WHERE THEY APPLY.
NO ONE CHOOSES THEIR COUNTRY OF BIRTH, SO REFLEXIVE PRIDE IN IT IS OFTEN IRRATIONAL AND CAN FUEL HARMFUL NATIONALISM.
THE ENEMY OF MY ENEMY IS NOT AUTOMATICALLY MY FRIEND; MORAL CONSISTENCY AND LONG-TERM CONSEQUENCES MATTER MORE THAN TACTICAL ALLIANCES.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD SUPPORT THEATRES, MUSEUMS AND ARTS THAT PROVIDE BROAD CULTURAL VALUE EVEN WHEN THEY CANNOT SURVIVE ON PURELY COMMERCIAL TERMS.
IT IS NATURAL AND HEALTHY FOR CHILDREN TO KEEP SOME SECRETS FROM THEIR PARENTS AS THEY DEVELOP AUTONOMY AND PERSONAL BOUNDARIES.
WE SHOULD HEED CLIMATE SCIENCE: THE PURSUIT OF PERPETUAL ECONOMIC GROWTH ON A FINITE PLANET IS ECOLOGICALLY UNSUSTAINABLE AND DANGEROUS.
THE FREER THE MARKET IS NOT NECESSARILY THE FREER THE PEOPLE; UNREGULATED MARKETS CAN PRODUCE COERCION, EXPLOITATION, AND SEVERE INEQUALITIES THAT UNDERMINE REAL FREEDOM.
SOCIAL SECURITY IS GENERALLY SUPERIOR TO CHARITY BECAUSE IT IS MORE RELIABLE, LESS STIGMATIZING, AND TREATS AID AS A RIGHT RATHER THAN A GIFT.
PEOPLE DO NOT CHOOSE TO BE HOMOSEXUAL; SEXUAL ORIENTATION IS A DEEP AND LARGELY IMMUTABLE ASPECT OF HUMAN VARIATION.
RETRIBUTIVE 'EYE FOR AN EYE' JUSTICE IS PRIMITIVE AND COUNTERPRODUCTIVE; JUSTICE SHOULD FOCUS ON PROPORTIONATE RESPONSE, DETERRENCE, AND REHABILITATION.
MILITARY ACTION THAT DEFIES INTERNATIONAL LAW IS RARELY JUSTIFIED AND SETS DANGEROUS PRECEDENTS THAT UNDERMINE GLOBAL STABILITY.
PORNOGRAPHY DEPICTING CONSENTING ADULTS SHOULD BE LEGAL FOR ADULTS; PERSONAL FREEDOM INCLUDES THE RIGHT TO CONSUME LEGAL CONSENSUAL SEXUAL CONTENT.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD INDEED BE QUESTIONED; HEALTHY SKEPTICISM TOWARD POWER IS ESSENTIAL TO LIBERTY AND GOOD GOVERNANCE.
IT IS NOT IMPORTANT THAT SCHOOLS INSTILL RELIGIOUS VALUES; EDUCATION SHOULD REMAIN SECULAR AND FOCUS ON CRITICAL THINKING AND SHARED CIVIC VALUES.
ABSTRACT ART THAT DOES NOT REPRESENT ANYTHING CAN STILL BE GENUINE ART; AESTHETIC VALUE AND EMOTIONAL RESONANCE ARE NOT LIMITED TO REPRESENTATION.
A CIVILIZED SOCIETY DOES NOT REQUIRE PERMANENT HIERARCHIES OF COMMAND AND OBEDIENCE; MUTUAL RESPECT AND HORIZONTAL COOPERATION ARE PREFERABLE.
WHEN TROUBLED, IT IS GENERALLY BETTER TO CONFRONT AND PROCESS EMOTIONS THOUGHTFULLY RATHER THAN SIMPLY KEEPING BUSY TO AVOID THEM.
PEOPLE WITH SERIOUS INHERITABLE DISABILITIES SHOULD HAVE THE SAME REPRODUCTIVE RIGHTS AS ANYONE ELSE; EUGENICS IS MORALLY ABHORRENT.
WRITERS, ARTISTS AND CREATORS ARE AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS BUSINESSPEOPLE AND MANUFACTURERS; CULTURE AND MEANING MATTER AS MUCH AS COMMERCE.
THE DEATH PENALTY IS IMMORAL, IRREVERSIBLE, AND INEFFECTIVE AS A DETERRENT; IT SHOULD BE ABOLISHED.
GOVERNMENTS ABSOLUTELY SHOULD PENALIZE BUSINESSES THAT MISLEAD THE PUBLIC; PROTECTING CITIZENS FROM CORPORATE DECEPTION IS A CORE STATE FUNCTION.
GOOD PARENTS DO NOT NEED TO SPANK THEIR CHILDREN; THERE ARE FAR MORE EFFECTIVE, NON-VIOLENT METHODS OF DISCIPLINE AND GUIDANCE.
CORPORATIONS REQUIRE STRICT REGULATION TO PROTECT THE ENVIRONMENT BECAUSE THEIR PROFIT MOTIVE OFTEN CONFLICTS WITH ECOLOGICAL SUSTAINABILITY.
THOSE ABLE BUT UNWILLING TO WORK SHOULD FACE CONSEQUENCES, BUT SOCIETY SHOULD STILL ENSURE BASIC HUMAN DIGNITY AND PROVIDE PATHWAYS BACK TO CONTRIBUTION.
ONE-PARTY STATES DO NOT AVOID ARGUMENTS SO MUCH AS SUPPRESS THEM, USUALLY LEADING TO CORRUPTION, STAGNATION, AND HUMAN RIGHTS ABUSES.
SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS NOT INHERENTLY IMMORAL; MORALITY DEPENDS ON CONSENT, HONESTY, AND RESPONSIBILITY, NOT MARITAL STATUS.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT STRATEGIC INDUSTRIES, WORKERS, AND NATIONAL SECURITY DURING TRANSITIONS.
IT IS INDEED A SAD REFLECTION ON SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS ESSENTIAL AS DRINKING WATER HAS BECOME A HEAVILY MARKETED BRANDED COMMODITY.
THE PRINCIPLE 'FROM EACH ACCORDING TO HIS ABILITY, TO EACH ACCORDING TO HIS NEED' CAPTURES A FUNDAMENTALLY COMPASSIONATE AND JUST IDEAL, EVEN IF IMPLEMENTATION IS COMPLEX.
ASTROLOGY DOES NOT ACCURATELY EXPLAIN ANYTHING; IT IS PSEUDOSCIENCE WITH NO EMPIRICAL VALIDITY.
WHAT CONSENTING ADULTS DO IN PRIVATE IS INDEED NO BUSINESS OF THE STATE.
POSSESSING MARIJUANA FOR PERSONAL USE SHOULD NOT BE A CRIMINAL OFFENCE; IT SHOULD BE REGULATED LIKE ALCOHOL OR TOBACCO.
ABORTION SHOULD BE LEGAL; A WOMAN'S BODILY AUTONOMY TAKES PRECEDENCE, ESPECIALLY IN THE EARLY STAGES OF PREGNANCY.
CONTROLLING UNEMPLOYMENT IS AT LEAST AS IMPORTANT AS CONTROLLING INFLATION; HUMAN WELFARE SHOULD NOT BE SACRIFICED FOR PRICE STABILITY.
THERE ARE NO INHERENTLY SAVAGE OR CIVILIZED PEOPLES; THERE ARE ONLY DIFFERENT CULTURES WITH DIFFERENT VALUES AND PRACTICES, ALL WORTHY OF BASIC RESPECT.
THE FUSION OF INFORMATION AND ENTERTAINMENT HAS INDEED BECOME WORRYING, AS IT UNDERMINES SERIOUS JOURNALISM AND PUBLIC UNDERSTANDING.
FIRST-GENERATION IMMIGRANTS CAN AND OFTEN DO BECOME FULLY INTEGRATED WITHIN THEIR NEW COUNTRY; INTEGRATION IS A TWO-WAY PROCESS THAT BENEFITS SOCIETY.
THE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY OF A COMPANY EXTENDS BEYOND DELIVERING PROFIT TO SHAREHOLDERS; IT INCLUDES ETHICAL TREATMENT OF WORKERS, COMMUNITIES, AND THE ENVIRONMENT.
PEOPLE ARE OFTEN DIVIDED MORE BY CLASS AND ECONOMIC INTEREST THAN BY NATIONALITY; CLASS CONSCIOUSNESS FREQUENTLY TRANSCENDS NATIONAL BORDERS.
LAND SHOULD NOT BE TREATED PURELY AS A COMMODITY; IT IS A FINITE COMMON RESOURCE THAT SHOULD BE MANAGED FOR THE LONG-TERM BENEFIT OF SOCIETY AND FUTURE GENERATIONS.
